title: Dadu Beemar Ho Gaye! 🤒 | Beemar Ke Liye Dua | Islamic Cartoon for Kids
description:
Dadu beemar ho gaye! 🤒 Ali aur Zara Dadu ka khayal rakhte hain — paani, teddy aur ek pyaari dua. Beemar ki iyadat (milne jaana) ki sunnat — bachchon ke liye ek pyaari Islamic kahani.

Dua: "La ba'sa, tahurun in sha Allah"
Matlab: Koi baat nahi, Allah chahe to yeh beemari (gunahon se) paak kar degi.
English: No worry, it is a purification, if Allah wills.

📖 Source:
• Beemar ke liye dua — Sahih Bukhari 5656, Sahih Bukhari 3616, Ibn Abbas (RA) (Sahih)

Aap ke ghar mein koi beemar ho to yeh dua zaroor padhein. Comment mein "Ameen" likhein! 🤲
Roz nayi kahani — Hidayah: Ali aur Dadu.
